reference.control: Search Directories GtkTextField-like VUE field, text .a, keyboard caret at x=16 in a 338x34 px native field

comparison.result: Both captures use the same 338x34 px field allocation, text, caret x position and white text role. At 1:1 scale, GTK2 draws a straight 1x18 px stem; VUE draws a 14 px stem with 5x1 px horizontal terminals at each end. This is a measured visual mismatch, not a palette mismatch.

method.pixel_rule: Classify near-white pixels (each RGB component >=250) in the exact native field crop; no resizing or interpolation. VUE crop is x=228..565,y=404..437. Verify endpoint row spans separately.
method.source_limit: The VUE caret image is a single captured phase; it does not establish the SR10.4 blink interval.

implementation_limit.finding: GTK 2.24.33 GtkEntry calls gtk_draw_insertion_cursor directly. GtkStyleClass has no insertion-cursor draw vfunc; its style cursor-aspect-ratio controls width, while text layout supplies height. A conventional GTK2 theme engine cannot add the VUE end caps or set only this caret's height to 14 px.
implementation_limit.action: Keep the current dynamic text-role 1 px GTK2 caret. Do not add static color or imply exact shape parity. Exact emulation requires an upstream/toolkit change or application-specific widget code, outside this theme-only correction.
